description:
A digital media company is launching a customer loyalty program. You need to modify the 'Customer' table in the Chinook database to add two new columns for tracking loyalty information.

Open the Customer table in Design/Edit mode (Right-click > Edit) and add the following two columns:

1. Column Name: LoyaltyPoints
   - Field Type: Integer [INTEGER]
   - Default Value: 0

2. Column Name: MembershipTier
   - Field Type: Text [VARCHAR] with length 20
   - Default Value: 'Bronze'

After adding both columns, save the table design (Ctrl+S) and close the table editor. Ensure you save your changes to the database file.
